name: FrenchModelVariant196_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/image16740_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (rings and beams); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs two textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/french-model-image16740-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-179/309 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/image16740_entry_usa.c, which selects the 240-line height, at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
